name: tower_lit_at_sunset
about: The setting sun lights a (golden light on the face you see): the sun is behind you, within 30 deg of straight behind, and a is in view. Its must (a at bearing 345-165 deg, the only side a sunset-lit face can be on) drops points before any skyline is traced, so use it as a must. For briefs like 'golden light on the tower (lab: lit-tower)'
